acceptanceCriteria: Define and qualify a supported archive/export and restore/import path for private Corvint enrollment state, checks and report bytes with immutable base/target binding.
Distinguish a genuinely inactive worktree from unavailable historical enrollment; preserve saved satisfied and unfinished states without inventing satisfaction or cancelling obligations.

Reproduce both satisfied and active workflow restoration with exact source identity and report/check verification; retain explicit limits for unrecoverable state and separate original integration workflows.
body: Observed 2026-10-01 in corpus GH399 worker. Related V1-0577 covers unknown archive attribution; this separate confirmed tooling gap covers evidence recovery. Two supported archived_worktree attachments were restored through restore_worktree: /Users/russelllewis/.codex/worktrees/0d4c/corvint (artifact01a0f4d6-da4e-7941-b2a2-d63c0da0810a) and /Users/russelllewis/.codex/worktrees/issue-399-public-port/corvint (artifact01a0f4d6-da72-72a1-92e4-0f2df80dd434). Restored clean heads match8686d39de014b2f755961811cf2b6211ad90532f and043cd2e612d2216e28a9bca34925b5d04c37a664. Gitdirs now corvint7 and corvint8 respectively. In both, the private corvint/local-completion/a0683c413945ccdb4e86f040b0dfc9181b70ab346ce753448e4dc514488afc45 directory is absent; keyed dogfood status returns inactive/satisfied:false. Saved original receipts prove prototype lifecycle satisfied at8686 and public-source begin ACTIVE/unfinished at25971; original report paths under former corvint8 are absent. Expected integration behavior: preserve or explicitly recover enrolled lifecycle/check/report evidence, or clearly block with a documented recovery procedure; restoring Git source alone cannot silently reset completion meaning. Actual supported restore recovers source but no live enrollment evidence at returned Gitdirs. Reproduce with exact artifact restores, git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir, existence check and corvint dogfood status --session-key. Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163; Tasks0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; Codex app/tool version NOT_OBSERVED. Evidence /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/corpus-archive-restoration.json and corpus-final-integration-proposal.json retain exact refs, trees, receipts and report hashes. Archive actor, cause, snapshot OIDs and other backup existence NOT_OBSERVED. No claim of permanent loss, app contract violation or attribution. No enrollment reset/restart/cancel performed.
title: Preserve or recover Corvint enrollment evidence across managed worktree archive/restore
